findings.title: Missing transaction boundaries around multi-node DAG operations
findings.description: LangGraph DAG executes intake_node → reasoning_node → memory_write_node → graph_sync_node sequence without transaction boundaries. Partial failures after memory writes leave inconsistent state across Neo4j, semantic embeddings, and checkpoints (ADR-0028 violation).
findings.impact: Data inconsistency across memory layers on partial DAG failure. Orphaned Neo4j nodes, dangling embeddings, unlinked checkpoints. Production data corruption risk.
findings.fix_strategy: Wrap entire DAG execution in PacketEnvelope transaction context with rollback on any node failure. Use substrate_service.begin_transaction() / commit_transaction() around graph.invoke().
findings.code_after:
async with substrate_service.begin_transaction(envelope):
    result = await graph.ainvoke(input, config)
    substrate_service.commit_transaction(result)
findings.test_snippet:
async def test_dag_partial_failure_rollback():
    envelope = PacketEnvelope(...)
    with patch('memory_write_node', side_effect=Exception('boom')):
        result = await dag.invoke({...})
        assert not neo4j_client.has_orphans(envelope.packet_id)

findings.title: PacketEnvelope.parent_ids access without length validation
findings.description: L9 pattern violation: PacketEnvelope.parent_ids accessed in reasoning_node without len(parent_ids) <= MAX_HIERARCHY_DEPTH check. Deeply nested packets cause stack overflow or memory exhaustion.
findings.impact: DoS via deeply recursive packet hierarchies. Exhausts stack/memory during DAG processing. Blocks legitimate ingestion.
findings.fix_strategy: Add MAX_HIERARCHY_DEPTH=10 validation in intake_node before downstream processing.
findings.test_snippet:
def test_parent_ids_depth_limit():
    envelope = PacketEnvelope(parent_ids=[str(uuid4())] * 11)
    state = await intake_node({...})
    assert 'Hierarchy depth 11 exceeds' in state['errors']

findings.title: Missing error recovery and state cleanup on DAG node failures
findings.description: intake_node early returns on validation failure without cleanup or PacketEnvelope rejection logging (ADR-0009). Downstream nodes lack try/except with state rollback.
findings.impact: Silent failures drop packets without audit trail. No recovery path for transient errors. Violates PacketEnvelope audit requirements.
findings.fix_strategy: Implement structured error handling with PacketEnvelope.rejected() state transition and cleanup callbacks.
findings.test_snippet:
async def test_intake_validation_failure():
    state = await intake_node({'envelope': {}})
    assert state['errors']
    mock_reject.assert_called()

findings.title: Validation logic in intake_node violates ADR-0012
findings.description: intake_node performs packet_type/payload validation. ADR-0012 mandates ALL validation occurs in intake_node ONLY. Duplicate validation elsewhere creates inconsistency.
findings.impact: Race between intake_node and substrate_service validation. Partial validation allows malformed packets downstream.
findings.fix_strategy: Move ALL validation to canonical intake_node. substrate_service calls validated intake_node exclusively.
findings.code_after:
# Validation moved to canonical validate_packet_schema() in intake_node
packet = validate_packet_schema(envelope)

findings.title: Neo4j client sessions leaked on node failure
findings.description: get_neo4j_client() called without context manager. Node failures leave open Neo4j sessions consuming connections (ADR-0033).
findings.impact: Connection pool exhaustion under load. DAG stalls after ~max_connections failures.
findings.fix_strategy: Use neo4j_client.session() context managers in all graph nodes.
findings.test_snippet:
async def test_neo4j_session_cleanup():
    with patch('neo4j.Session.close') as mock_close:
        try: await failing_node(state)
        finally:
            assert mock_close.called

findings.title: Empty payload handling missing in skip_embedding check
findings.description: _should_skip_embedding(text='') returns True but doesn't log or audit empty payload rejection.
findings.impact: Silent dropping of valid zero-length payloads (edge case). No audit trail for empty packet processing.
findings.fix_strategy: Add PacketEnvelope audit log for skipped embeddings.
